# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to function not specified |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s ecosystem opportunity depends on making Claude useful in complex enterprise environments while retaining the trust associated with its safety-led brand. This position appears designed to create leverage between partner reach,
technical credibility, and consistent customer outcomes.

The core operating tension is expansion without fragmentation. External delivery organizations can extend market coverage quickly, yet every customer-facing implementation also shapes perceptions of Claude’s reliability, security, and
practical value. Strong shared methods, clear technical judgment, and disciplined learning loops are likely essential.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is an AI safety and research company structured as a public benefit corporation. Its stated identity centers on reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI, positioning safety and usefulness as mutually reinforcing rather than
separate priorities.

Claude spans business, analytical, and software-oriented work. That breadth gives Anthropic a large enterprise solution surface, but it also makes use-case discipline important: customers and partners need to connect model capabilities
to specific workflows, operating constraints, and measurable business value.

The commercial model increasingly combines product innovation with enterprise adoption. Success therefore requires more than access to a model or application; it requires organizational readiness, secure administration, practical
implementation choices, user confidence, and support for sustained usage.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic presents Claude as a tool for tackling complex challenges, analyzing information, and supporting coding and knowledge-work tasks. This creates potential across industries, but broad applicability can produce diffuse partner
messaging unless teams establish a small number of repeatable solution narratives.

Enterprise deployment materials indicate that implementation is treated as a lifecycle. Technical configuration, organizational launch, governance, and adoption planning all influence whether an initial initiative becomes durable usage.

The strategic pressure is to convert strong product interest into production-grade business outcomes at scale. This increases the value of reusable architecture patterns, partner readiness models, quality controls, and mechanisms that
separate recurring needs from account-specific exceptions.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Anthropic’s public identity is closely associated with safety, reliability, and beneficial AI. For a partner-facing architecture leader, that means technical decisions and customer interactions carry both commercial and brand significance.

Likely internal stakeholders include:

- Enterprise, security, and customer-facing functions, which need common expectations for deployment quality, escalation, and customer experience.
- Safety, policy, and governance-oriented teams, which help ensure external solution patterns remain aligned with Anthropic’s public commitments.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic emphasizes safety, accuracy, security, reliability, interpretability, and steerability. In enterprise settings, these attributes are not simply product messages; they influence how buyers assess risk, how partners frame
solutions, and how implementation teams set expectations.

Claude is relevant to both business workflows and technical work. A scalable partner approach will likely require differentiated patterns rather than generic AI narratives: clear problem framing, data and system boundaries, success
criteria, evaluation practices, and operational ownership.

Enterprise materials highlight security, compliance, administration, technical setup, and organizational rollout. These signals favor a practical architecture discipline that addresses identity, access, governance, adoption, evaluation,
support boundaries, and escalation before a solution becomes broadly repeatable.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic describes a network of cloud, technology, and services partners supporting customers’ AI initiatives. This suggests the ecosystem is a meaningful route to enterprise adoption, not merely a supplemental referral channel.

The partner model appears oriented toward joint customer outcomes. Cloud providers, technology partners, and services firms can help customers connect Claude to existing operating environments, transformation programs, and delivery
capacity.

Accenture’s public framing of its relationship with Anthropic emphasizes enterprise AI deployment, productivity, value creation, and new product development. This is a useful indication that services partners are expected to move beyond
introductions toward practical implementation and customer change.

The opportunity is to create partner plays that are repeatable without becoming rigid. Effective standards can increase partner independence while protecting technical quality, governance consistency, and the usefulness of feedback
returned from the field.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s enterprise adoption resources make clear that successful rollout involves both technology and organizational change. The company is signaling an interest in durable usage rather than one-time experimentation.

A growing public partner network increases the need for consistent technical positioning and delivery methods. As more external teams present Claude to enterprise customers, variation in solution quality can become a commercial,
reputational, and product-learning risk.

The broader market is moving toward governed production AI. Anthropic’s safety-centered positioning can be a meaningful advantage when customers seek dependable deployment, provided that partners can make the value concrete and operate
within clear quality boundaries.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Scaling technical partner organizations in fast-changing, high-ambiguity environments.
- Turning enterprise AI concepts into reusable delivery methods, governance models, and adoption plans.
- Translating sophisticated platform capabilities into practical industry and workflow architectures.
- Building enablement systems that raise partner capability while preserving quality and customer trust.
- Connecting alliance strategy with field execution, product learning, engineering priorities, security, and customer success.
- Establishing structured mechanisms for converting implementation insight into actionable product signals.
- Positioning responsible AI, governance, security, and change management as accelerators of enterprise value.
- Shaping technical strategy for complex ecosystem-influenced opportunities.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s ecosystem appears important to moving Claude from initial interest to sustained enterprise use.
- Enterprise rollout guidance signals that organizational adoption deserves equal attention to technical configuration.
- Claude’s relevance across analysis, knowledge work, and coding increases the value of adaptable solution patterns.
- A safety- and reliability-oriented market position raises the strategic importance of consistent partner execution.
- The Accenture relationship suggests implementation partners have a significant role in operationalizing enterprise AI.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
